source.author: Wungus
source.title: [25.17] A Guide to Might and Joy

fields: One of Nilah's hardest ADC lanes: her feathers zone you and her ultimate dodges your engage. Banning her is the cleanest answer, though since she is rarely picked, Smolder may be the better ban.

His short range is his only weakness. He pokes you to build stacks, his W covers a huge area, and his E completely counters your engage. He keeps scaling and becomes very hard to stop from around 20 minutes, so he is a strong ban.
She is very hard to reach and deals solid lane damage. Your best chance is an engage support who can lock her down for you.
His early game is weak if you have an engage support, so you can build a lead by playing well. He will still outscale you regardless.
He wants to brawl just like you. You should win before level 6, but after that his ultimate makes fights hard; if you have no lead by then, farm safely and never duel him.
She kites well, harasses constantly, and her spell shield blocks your engage. Coordinate engages with your support, and if you get ahead of her you are in a great position.
She keeps you at a distance very effectively. Dodge her net, close the gap by dashing to minions or with Galeforce, and use your W to avoid headshots.
He has range, strong wave clear and good poke. Play with your team and punish him while his long cooldowns are down.
He bullies you early and his W can set up kills with his support. Survive lane with your W and good positioning; later in the game he is easy to kill.

Standard Kai'Sa relies on her passive and isolated Q; your W delays the passive proc and staying near your support or minions blunts her Q. The AP Lich Bane version is a Major threat that bombards from range, but it comes online slowly, so shut her down early.
Like Swain but easier. Use your E mobility to dodge his Q, and since he is squishier, snowballing a lead against him is simpler.
Her constant slows and ultimate are annoying. Take Cleanse for her arrow and dash to minions to close the distance.

He punishes walking up for the wrong last hit and can put you in kill range quickly. Play safe, farm carefully and stay in XP range; if you hit level 3 first you can kill him, and if you leave lane ahead in gold he stops being a problem.
Similar to Draven: one mistake and you die. With an engage support and by reaching level 3 first, you can lock her down and kill her.
She struggles to poke you in lane, but from level 6 her mobility becomes a problem. CC plus burst handles her.
Her Tumble hits hard after recent buffs, so she can bully you if you are careless, and she kites well. Play near your support and use W to dodge her empowered autos.
She is dangerous if ignored, but very squishy. Burn her Flash and play with your support; once you are on top of her without Flash, she usually dies.
His early game is far stronger than yours. Protect your health, look for XP leads, and consider Exhaust to blunt his damage.
The only issue is closing the gap against his range. Items, dashing through minions or an engage support solve it.
She struggles to damage you outside her ultimate. Position to avoid her bouncing Q in lane and you should win fights.
Her range is annoying in lane, but if you dodge her W and avoid her traps, she is an easy target.
He can poke with some weapons and hit very hard with others, but he has little self-peel. Your W is excellent against him and your mobility overwhelms him.
He has long range and little else. Take Cleanse for his ultimate and burn his Flash, and he has few answers.
Staying behind minions shuts down his poke. His E makes him hard to kill, but playing with your support makes it possible.
An easy lane: she is short ranged, has no projectiles of yours to block, and your ultimate counters hers. Your W can also deny her style stacks and delay her ultimate.
Your W stops her from all-inning you. Her W and ultimate make her hard to finish, so play with your team to secure kills.
Your W makes it hard for him to stack his passive. Dash onto him when he positions badly for autos; AP Twitch is harder but still manageable.
AD Twisted Fate is all autos, so as long as you dodge his gold card you should be fine.
The author has limited experience here, but as an auto-attacker she suits Nilah. Save your W for when she activates her Q.
